'''2011 Yavin 4 Regionals Joe Orthner LS Careful Planning''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Orthner]] at [[2011 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Careful Planning|Endor-L-carefulplanning.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Freedom!!!
* '''Username:''' Grawaines
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
